@echo off
cd /d C:\Users\endos
where claude >nul 2>&1 && (claude & goto :end)
where npx >nul 2>&1 && (npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest & goto :end)
node "%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@anthropic-ai\claude-code\cli.js" 2>nul && goto :end
echo Claude CLI not found. Run: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
pause
:end

msg: Global install @anthropic-ai/claude-code so claude command works directly
